title: monki-focus policy token claims (v1)
description: Claims of a PASETO v4.public policy token, signed with the policy-signing key. The signed message must also be the canonical serialisation of these claims (docs/protocol/unlock-tokens.md §4.0). Semantic rules beyond this schema: iat <= nbf < exp; exp - iat <= 2592000 (30 days); iss and dev equal the pinned issuer and this device; ver never decreases on a device.

dev.description: Device uuid the token is bound to (also bound by the implicit assertion).

tz.description: IANA time zone the policy is evaluated in.

rules_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical rule-set document in force.

issuer.description: Instance origin. Release: lowercase https://host, no port, path or trailing slash. Development only: http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1 with an optional non-default port. Never contains "|".

subject.description: Opaque user id on the instance.

rfc3339Utc.description: UTC instant as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (whole seconds, no offset, year >= 1970). Verifiers also check that the day exists in its month (no 2026-02-30), which a pattern cannot express.
